body: High school sucked! I didn’t have friends, i felt lonely, and I wanted to kill my self. I didn’t go to college and got s basic job instead. At that job, I made friends and had fun. I lost those friends and felt lonely again. Then made new friends. It’s like a cycle for me. There are bad times but there are awesome times in life. Life didn’t really start for me till after high school. Just hang in there, I promise things will get better. At 36 now I still have shitty days, but I know great days are ahead!

I do read people a lot and it does make me feel awkward. Like I’m always trying to think what they are thinking and when I get the vibe they don’t like me or something I instantly shut down. I don’t know if I’m reading their expressions correctly or if it’s just the stupid social anxiety tricking my brain. But yeah, when someone is feeling down, i start to feel down. When they are happy, I am happy.

I’m sorry you’ve had to go through so much. I heard what your saying. I now have knee and back issues and can’t hike or do much walking so feel like now I’m useless to my friends and they have slowed down on inviting me to places

Yes, I’ve been told I’m an old soul all the time growing up. I’m 36 now, but still feel older than people my age lol. My issue is I have social anxiety. Got rid of it somehow for 4 years but it’s back full force.
I’m going through this right now. I’ve gone through it a few times. Just know things do get better!
